title: AIWF Loop State
description: Turn-driven loop controller state persisted at .agents/state/loop/<workflow-id>.json. Additive-only over the linear pipeline; absence of this file implies iteration 0.

current_phase.description: The workflow phase the controller is currently on.

iteration.description: Rework attempts on current_phase; reset to 0 on ADVANCE/BACKTRACK.

max_iterations.description: Hard ceiling of rework attempts before a MAX_ITERATIONS HALT.

no_progress_count.description: Consecutive cycles with an identical failure_signature.

no_progress_threshold.description: Additive config: no-progress cycles before a NO_PROGRESS HALT.

failure_signature.description: SHA-256 hex over normalized blocking findings; empty when none.

backtrack_target.description: Phase a BACKTRACK points to (e.g. spike fail -> brainstorming).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp stamped at persist time.
